scope: Four-step Properties and analysis cache refactor, on top of GitHub issue 100

implementation.invalidation: Operation-owned dependency counters; conservative all-domain fallback; ordered selection in Properties key; monotonically invalidated history and document-generation guards
implementation.properties: Owned snapshot of labels, aggregated values, eligibility, statistics and dimensions; fixed-height target list clipped; edits applied after drawing
implementation.runtime: Separate source, job, result, GPU and inspector structs; scheduling in comparison_runtime.cpp and resource operations in comparison_gpu.cpp
implementation.freshness: Explicit mesh content revisions; shared readiness checks; per-stage uploaded result revisions; late worker and document-replacement protection

method.fixtures: Synthetic groups referencing a triangle, not a native San Miguel performance capture
method.query_measurement: Mean of 10000 warm updateSceneInspector calls in microseconds
method.properties_draw_measurement: Median of 9 warm drawing samples after 3 warm-up frames, milliseconds; excludes NewFrame/EndFrame
method.analysis_draw_measurement: Median of 9 warm complete fixture frames, milliseconds
notes: Other workloads were not controlled; absolute timings vary.
Expanded analysis source trees still draw their expanded rows; tree virtualization is outside this refactor.
These timings do not establish native-model FPS or resident-memory usage.
